items.sujet:
My name is Salim. I am fifteen and I live in Setif. I am a first-year secondary student. I like English because it is useful. My best friend is Yacine. We are in the same class.
I. Reading (8 pts)
1. True/False:
a) Salim is fifteen.
b) Salim lives in Oran.
c) Yacine is his brother.
d) They are in the same class.
2. Answer:
e) Where does Salim live?
f) Why does he like English?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. I __ (be) a student. · She __ (live) in Setif.
2. __ your name? (question)
3. My friend __ (like) English.
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « GETTING THROUGH ».
items.corrige:
I.1 a T · b F (Setif) · c F · d T
I.2 e) He lives in Setif. · f) Because it is useful.
II. am / lives · What is · likes
III. Model: « Hello, I am Amel. I am 15. I live in Blida. I like English. »

items.sujet:
Last summer, my family visited Constantine. We walked on the bridge and took many photos. I saw the old city and I liked it very much. It was a wonderful day.
I. Reading (8 pts)
1. True/False:
a) The family visited Constantine last summer.
b) They visited Algiers.
c) They took many photos.
d) It was a bad day.
2. Answer:
e) What did they see?
f) How was the day?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. We __ (visit) Constantine.
2. I __ (see) the old city.
3. They __ (not / go) home early.
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « ONCE UPON A TIME ».
items.corrige:
I.1 a T · b F · c T · d F
I.2 e) They saw the old city. · f) It was wonderful.
II. visited · saw · didn't go
III. Model: « Last week I visited my grandmother. We talked and I helped her. »

items.sujet:
Scientists have studied the internet and its effects. They have found that young people use it every day. The results show that the internet is useful but it can be dangerous.
I. Reading (8 pts)
1. True/False:
a) Scientists have studied the internet.
b) Young people never use it.
c) It can be dangerous.
d) The results are secret.
2. Answer:
e) What have scientists studied?
f) What have they found?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. They __ (study) the internet.
2. She __ (find) a result.
3. __ you ever __ (use) it?
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « OUR FINDINGS SHOW ».
items.corrige:
I.1 a T · b F · c T · d F
I.2 e) The internet and its effects. · f) That young people use it every day.
II. have studied · has found · Have / used
III. Model: « I have read many articles. I have learned new things. »

items.sujet:
Great inventors have changed our life. Edison invented the light bulb and Bell invented the telephone. We must be curious and ask questions to discover new things.
I. Reading (8 pts)
1. True/False:
a) Edison invented the light bulb.
b) Bell invented the car.
c) Inventors have changed our life.
d) We must not ask questions.
2. Answer:
e) Who invented the telephone?
f) What must we be?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. Edison __ (invent) the bulb in 1879.
2. Scientists __ (discover) many things.
3. It __ be true (must/can't).
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « EUREKA! ».
items.corrige:
I.1 a T · b F · c T · d F
I.2 e) Bell. · f) Curious.
II. invented · have discovered · must
III. Model: « Edison invented the bulb. Scientists have changed the world. »

items.sujet:
Nature is beautiful but it is in danger. If we pollute the rivers, the fish will die. We should protect the environment and plant more trees.
I. Reading (8 pts)
1. True/False:
a) Nature is in danger.
b) If we pollute rivers, fish will die.
c) We should cut trees.
d) The environment is beautiful.
2. Answer:
e) What will happen if we pollute rivers?
f) What should we do?
II. Language (8 pts)
1. If it rains, we __ (stay) home.
2. We __ (protect) nature (should).
3. If we __ (plant) trees, air will be clean.
III. Writing (4 pts)
Write 5 sentences about « BACK TO NATURE ».
items.corrige:
I.1 a T · b T · c F · d T
I.2 e) The fish will die. · f) Protect the environment and plant trees.
II. will stay · should protect · plant
III. Model: « If I have time, I will plant a tree. We should protect nature. »
